c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Flavor: refine (human-confirmed). Seeded from board open threads: adjudicate x1 contradictions (q1-q4), superpowers reconciliation (q5), curator shape via design-it-twice excursion (x1), installer/runtime-context verification incl. manifest.json + template diffs (x2). Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: refine cycle framed; c2-x1 (curator design-it-twice panel) and c2-x2 (runtime-context verification) registered for background dispatch; q1-q5 adjudications queued

q1.title: Contradiction (a): what belongs in the description field?
q1.imperative: Anthropic: description states what + when-to-use with triggers. Obra: never summarize the workflow in the description. Adjudicate for our corpus. Recommend; human decides.
q1.finding: DECIDED: descriptions carry triggering conditions (what / when to use / when NOT to use) but never procedure - no step names or workflow verbs an agent could follow instead of reading the body.

q2.title: Contradiction (b): capitalized imperatives vs explain-the-why
q2.imperative: Adjudicate the register for our doctrine text. Affects cluster A wording and the FOLLOW-STRICTLY deletion. Recommend; human decides.
q2.finding: DECIDED: default register is rule-plus-why (one clause of reason). Emphatic register reserved for rationalization-prone gates (convergence, UNCONFIRMED marker, evidence-before-claims) and those spots should carry a mechanical check backing the prose. Free-floating emphasis unattached to a mechanism (FOLLOW THIS SKILL STRICTLY banners) is deleted.

q3.title: Contradiction (c): eval rigor bar for skill changes
q3.imperative: Anthropic >=3 evals recommended vs obra Iron-Law TDD-for-skills. Given cluster E is tackle-last and q3-cycle1 rejects over-machinery, adjudicate the bar. Recommend; human decides.
q3.finding: DECIDED: no Iron Law. Eval harness (cluster E) ships as an available tool; situational bar: new skill or behavior-changing rewrite gets >=1 fresh-context eval run before install; mechanical edits (dedup, description tightening, typos) need only existing tests + git review. Curator may flag when an eval run is warranted - flag, not gate.

q4.title: Contradiction (d): pushy vs precise descriptions
q4.imperative: Recall vs precision of skill triggering. Adjudicate default posture for our corpus. Recommend; human decides.
q4.finding: DECIDED: precision over pushiness; exclusion clauses NOT blanket - only where a real confusable neighbor exists: scout/cartographer, explorer/interrogator, admiral/commander, curator/scout+write-a-skill. Crew skills are dispatched by name (no description-based selection) - no clauses there. Blanket-mandatory clause rejected as boilerplate accretion.

q5.title: Superpowers reconciliation
q5.imperative: Human decisions: (i) removing superpowers skills from this box - in scope for this pass or separate chore? (ii) ROADMAP superpowers-imports arc: survives as study-competitor-import-nothing-verbatim, or dies? Recommend; human decides.
q5.finding: DECIDED: (i) superpowers removal from box = separate chore, outside this design. (ii) ROADMAP arc survives reframed: four ideas (durable progress ledger, file-based handoff hygiene, model-tier selection, pre-flight conflict scan) kept as constellation-native items with deletion-test evaluation; superpowers-imports framing dropped; section renamed. Study competitor results, import no wording, no dependency.

x1.title: Excursion: curator skill design-it-twice (3-agent panel)
x1.imperative: One named question: what is the right interface/shape for constellation-curator (the periodic corpus-maintenance skill)? 3 parallel agents under distinct constraints (minimal-interface; scout-analog; measurement-first). Compared on depth/locality/seam/testability -> opinionated recommendation or named hybrid. Brief on board. Background dispatch. Result: excursions/c2-x1-curator-dit.md.
x1.finding: Panel of 3 landed + comparison. HUMAN PICKED: measure-then-mend hybrid - curate_corpus.py script core (flags-never-gates in code, baseline drift diff), mechanical mends applied in place (git-reviewed, no engine checklist), design decisions routed to Triage; human-only invoker, agent-audit mode recorded as untaken road.

x2.title: Excursion: installer/runtime-context verification (research)
x2.imperative: One named question: what does each role actually see at runtime after install, and would cluster-A dedup change it? Verify installer bundling behavior, whether manifest.json is read, per-tier reference bundles, and diff IMPLEMENTER vs REVIEWER handoff template bodies. Brief on board. Background dispatch. Result: excursions/c2-x2-runtime-context.md.
x2.finding: Runtime-context verified: installer bundles _shared per SKILL_REFERENCE_BUNDLES (install_constellation.py:98-113); every skill gets global-everyone+windows; tier buckets on top. ALL cluster-A moves are GO with bucket rules: cross-tier doctrines (scoped-nulls, world-verification, mandatory-boilerplate, engine string) MUST go to global-everyone; orch-only pairs (unchanged-tree, crew-idle, delegate-not-replacement) fit global-orchestrator. q5 kill condition defused: no role loses doctrine. Tests pin bundle set via global-*.md glob - append to EXISTING bucket files, do not create new global-*.md names. manifest.json is dead code (nothing reads it) - safe to delete. Handoff template diff: genuinely different, low dedup payoff, leave separate. Not checked: byte-identity of inline wordings; test suite not executed.

q6.title: Dual entry points for both-invoked skills?
q6.imperative: Human-raised follow-up: commander and interrogator straddle human-led and agent-led invocation. Do both-class skills get a human entry point AND an agent entry point over common templates - different ways of interacting with the same template interface? Explore shapes (two skills / two entry sections in one SKILL.md / agent-first body + human wrapper); recommend; human decides.
q6.finding: DECIDED: split-where-heavy. Both-invoked roles with real, heavy mode deltas (commander, interrogator) become two entry-only skills (human entry + agent/delegated entry) over a joint core reference - single source, no competing instructions in context; installer already supports via per-skill bundle map or cross-skill absolute-path pointer (precedent: checklist-engine.md); avoid new global-*.md names (test glob). Shallow both-skills (cartographer, scout, triage, prototyper) keep a one-line mode note; graduate to split only if a real second audience grows. Untaken roads: entry blocks in one file (B); uniform split (A); primary-audience-only (C).

consolidation.summary: Refine cycle 2 complete: all four x1 contradictions adjudicated (triggers-not-procedure descriptions; rule-plus-why register with mechanism-backed emphasis only; situational eval bar, no Iron Law; precision-over-pushiness with exclusion clauses only for the ~4 confusable pairs). Curator converged: measure-then-mend hybrid, human-only. NEW human-raised decision: split-where-heavy entry skills (commander, interrogator -> human entry + delegated entry over joint core reference; shallow both-skills keep one-line mode note). Runtime-context verified: all cluster-A dedup GO with bucket rules; manifest.json dead -> delete; handoff templates stay separate. Superpowers: box removal separate chore; ROADMAP arc reframed native. Remaining open: eval-harness minimal shape (E, last); wording reconciliation per dedup move (execution detail).
